items.title: Anatomy of a (Postgres) search engine — PlanetScale
items.summary: PlanetScale's TIN (Term-Inverted-Normalization) is a full-text search index for Postgres, supporting features like sorting and matching by exact value, range, or prefix. An inverted index is used to locate documents quickly by words, and a term dictionary maps terms to postings lists.
